environment.build: Locked offline workspace; unchanged Qt 6.11.2 toolchain and dependency graph.
environment.measurement_runner: Qt Quick/WebEngine offscreen software runner; 640x480 CSS viewport; devicePixelRatio 1; QtWebEngine Chrome 140.0.0.0.
environment.scope: Explicit Grid double-click request through the public Qt pointer adapter; local-source boundary; unavailable production gate until Wayland qualification.

baseline_comparison: Implementation started from S18 evidence tip 0528d7ec55472cb4de697772bb9d5ff49bdbabd7. No dependency, lockfile, or toolchain changes. The initial full-suite run exposed the Qt window-wide click counter reusing the preceding fixture's identical coordinates; the final fixture isolates the target beyond the configured double-click distance and passes in the full suite.

observations: One enabled production-adapter request produced two trusted DOM click events followed by one trusted dblclick; click detail values were 1 and 2, and dblclick detail was 2.

Transient user activation was active for each recorded DOM event. The fixture observed two click handlers, one double-click handler, an unchanged document URL, one delivered acknowledgement, and rejection of a duplicate request ID.
The default-disabled adapter path returned unavailable and produced no DOM events. These facts apply only to the tested offscreen Qt/WebEngine build.
The final integrated engine run passed 144 Qt Quick/WebEngine tests and native_insert CTest 1/1, including the double-click adapter case.

test_results.reason: The nested Weston compositor lacks the virtual-keyboard protocol required by wtype. Startup smoke passed, but native editable-page input and double-click qualification could not run.
observations: Startup-only Wayland smoke is not treated as physical input qualification.
The one-pending terminal request and Grid-only chord tests passed; aliases could not replay grid-double-click through CLI, IPC, switcher, userscript, or macro sources.

test_results.reason: The current fixtures do not compose a physical local Grid key, BrowserUi owner/permit handoff, QML request, and native adapter dispatch. The direct adapter fixture does not establish that full local UI authority journey.
The fixture records isTrusted and transient activation, but does not exercise fullscreen, popup, clipboard, or chooser outcomes; those permission-gated API results remain unqualified.
Physical Wayland input could not run because the nested Weston compositor lacks the virtual-keyboard protocol required by wtype; permission-gated outcomes were not exercised.

observations: Locked workspace tests passed, including 441 core tests and the engine crate tests; one pre-existing test remains ignored.
The full Qt Quick/WebEngine fixture suite passed 144 tests.

All 144 Qt Quick/WebEngine tests and native_insert CTest 1/1 passed on the final adapter implementation. The final Ferric application also passed the bounded offscreen startup smoke recorded in S19-adapter-smoke.log.
Generated commands, bindings, configuration, and action references from the registries.

Command registry and IPC schema tests passed; generated user docs, requirements traceability, resource manifests, and workspace checks passed. cargo xtask docs also regenerated commands, bindings, configuration, and action references.

test_results.command: CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked --offline -- -D warnings; cargo fmt --all -- --check; git diff --check
observations: Strict workspace Clippy completed with Rust -D warnings clean. Compiler output contains existing Qt/GCC generated-C++ warnings.
Rust formatting and whitespace checks passed on the final tree.

remaining_risks: Native Wayland double-click input and the composed local Grid-to-BrowserUi-to-adapter authority handoff remain unqualified, so the runtime gate is hardcoded false.
Fullscreen, popup, clipboard, and chooser outcomes were not exercised; observed trust and transient activation do not imply those APIs will be granted.
A page may act on both click events before handling dblclick. One request therefore means one native double-click attempt, not exactly-once page activation.
The measured event order and activation behavior apply only to Qt 6.11.2 / QtWebEngine 6.11.2 in the offscreen software runner. No live-site or broader platform claim is made.

T014 native-qt-offscreen: permission-gated fullscreen, popup, clipboard, and chooser outcome cases were not exercised.
T014 native-wayland and T046 native-wayland: nested Weston lacks the virtual-keyboard protocol required by wtype; only bounded startup smoke passed.
